answer: Entering the meadow, a new identity serves 3 probation epochs, earning nothing until graduation. Each epoch it files a census, via a raven courier, with one receipted task and a 65-credit fee. Auditors check the census against the grove registry; a missed or borrowed census resets the clock, burning the fee, stopping a rented-census ring. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 3 x 65 = 19,500 credits and 300 filings; an honest agent pays 195 once.
